query:
WITH
            pos_authors AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS author_id
                FROM authors a
                WHERE a.name ILIKE '%' || $1::TEXT || '%'
            ),
            post_match AS (
                SELECT ap.post_id
                FROM author_posts ap
                JOIN pos_authors pa ON pa.author_id = ap.author_id
            )
            SELECT p.id, p.title
            FROM post_match pm
            JOIN posts p ON p.id = pm.post_id
            LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3;
